top_signals.title: Stocks Slip and Treasury Rally Fades as Oil Climbs: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A rebound in long-dated Treasuries ran out of steam and US stock futures fell as rising oil prices put inflation risks back on investors’ radar.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: PGIM Inks Deal For $3 Billion of GreenSky Home Improvement Loans
top_signals.summary: Prudential Financial Inc.’s asset-management arm will purchase up to $3 billion of home improvement loans from lender GreenSky under a three-year arrangement, handing the asset manager a slice of the booming market for home upgrades and repairs.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
